Package swiss.trustbroker.script.service

Class ScriptService

java.lang.Object
swiss.trustbroker.script.service.ScriptService
@Service public class ScriptService extends Object
Service implements flexibility hooks for the XTB Processing Model. Specifically the scripts hooks specified in XTB Configuration.
